note: Reference screens of the English visual gate (pc/tools/test_visual_sweep.py): each entry is a playthrough script and the `shot` labels whose English screenshot must show no Japanese glyph (tools/patch/visual_sweep.py Detector, >= min_hits hits fails). `ja_hits` lists the shots that must show Japanese in TOKI_LANG=ja (the negative control: the detector sees the text the English build replaced). No pixels are stored; the screenshots are taken at test time. `art_routes`: scenarios (pc/tools/scenario.py, swept with PC_SWEEP_DIR every `sweep_every` frames) whose lettering the detector cannot read (banners, logos): each `art` cell (a src/patch/art manifest cell) must show as our English PNG on some English picture and its retail lettering (cut from the player's file at test time) on none; the Japanese run must show the retail lettering (negative control) and never ours (visual_sweep.picture_at); an `erase_only` cell (a counter word English drops) is only checked for the retail lettering. A route may also list `art` cells (Rei Ijuin's name card on the tour): the presence check of the art routes on the route's own sweep pictures; `region` [x, y, w, h] is the part of the cell a sprite in front leaves visible. The borrowing race's DISQUALIFIED stamp (src/patch/art/KARI) is drawn translucent, so its colours never match a screen picture: it is gated on the file (tools/patch/test_art_frames_2026_11_03.py) and its scenario (scene114_taiiku_kari_foul.txt) is for review.
